events.name: US Chicago Fed National Activity Index
events.description: Broad monthly gauge combining 85 indicators of economic activity, useful for spotting inflection points in growth.

events.name: Mexico CPI (Y-o-Y)
events.description: Bi-weekly reading of Mexican consumer prices, watched by Banxico as it weighs the pace of further rate cuts.

events.name: Germany GDP (Q-o-Q)
events.description: Detailed final estimate of Germany's second-quarter growth, providing a fuller breakdown of the Eurozone's largest economy.

events.name: US Consumer Confidence
events.description: Conference Board gauge of US household views on current conditions and job prospects, a leading signal for spending.

events.name: US GDP (Q-o-Q)
events.description: Second estimate of Q2 US growth, incorporating fuller trade, inventory and services data than the advance reading.

events.name: US Core PCE Price Index (Y-o-Y)
events.description: The Fed's preferred inflation gauge excluding food and energy, central to the outlook for interest rate policy.

events.name: US Initial Jobless Claims
events.description: Weekly count of new unemployment benefit filings, a timely, high-frequency read on the health of the US labour market.

events.name: China Industrial Profits (Y-o-Y)
events.description: Cumulative Jan-Jul profit growth at large Chinese industrial firms, a gauge of corporate health and demand momentum.

events.name: Fed Chair Jackson Hole Keynote
events.description: Chair Kevin Warsh's first Jackson Hole address, closely watched for signals on the path of US monetary policy.

events.name: Japan Tokyo CPI (Y-o-Y)
events.description: Preliminary Tokyo inflation reading, a leading indicator for national CPI closely watched by the BoJ for price trends.
